messages:
sam: Heads-up — canary in ap-southeast failed during the staggered rollout. Crashloop on the nightly cronjob pod, job never runs. logs show timezone mismatch in ENV

maria: ack. which chart/version?

sam: web-cron chart bumped to 2.4.0 in this deploy (was 2.3.1). 2.4.0 added TZ env override (TZ=UTC) in values. our region expects TZ=Asia/Singapore for scheduled jobs. quick diff: 
```helm get values release-web-cron --revision 2 | grep TZ```
shows TZ set to UTC

leo: Oof. Canary only in ap-southeast right now?

sam: yes only ap-southeast picked the new value; other regions still on 2.3.1 and fine. deploy-bot shows partial promotion stuck on health gate for that canary.

deploy-bot: promotion paused: canary_health_check_failed (cronjob lastSuccessful 1970-01-01) :exclamation:

anya: Two immediate options: 1) rollback the chart in ap-southeast to 2.3.1, or 2) pin the values for the rest of rollout (keep image + chart but override TZ back to Asia/Singapore via values override).

maria: pinning values buys time and keeps the rest of regions moving. rollback would be safer for correctness but slower. what do we want for production?

leo: Can we do a targeted values override for ap-southeast only (release-level) and continue the rest? That avoids rolling back code. Steps?

anya: yes — use a regional values override on the release group. Example: 
```bash
helm upgrade release-web-cron myrepo/web-cron --version 2.4.0 --set-string env.TZ=Asia/Singapore --namespace prod-ap-southeast
```
That keeps chart 2.4.0 but restores TZ. Then re-run canary probe.

sam: I can apply that now and rerun the canary health check. Will also prepare a rollback command if things escalate: 
```bash
helm rollback release-web-cron 1 --namespace prod-ap-southeast
```

leo: Go for pin first. maria, can you draft a one-line release note blurb for the hotfix and mark that we changed regional values? we'll need it in the release notes doc and changelog.

maria: on it — "Hotfix: regional values override applied to ap-southeast to restore cronjob TZ after chart 2.4.0 introduced default UTC TZ." :memo:

deploy-bot: action queued: helm upgrade (override) in prod-ap-southeast by sam.

sam: applied override, pods restarted, cronjob lastSuccessful now shows a timestamp. Rerunning the canary health checks.

dev-bot: canary pass recorded: all checks OK. Promotion unblocked. Proceeding with staged promotion to remaining regions. :white_check_mark:

leo: nice work. keep the changelog entry and include the follow-up item: update chart docs to call out TZ default and add a migration note. we'll follow up with the chart owner to avoid future surprises.

maria: added follow-up TODO in release notes. closing thread once release notes are merged. :thumbsup:
